correctness.rationale: The eight signed-coordinate six-vertex octahedra partition all 96 graph edges. Pair sums a,b,c in {-2,0,2} yield local energy ab+ac+bc >= -4 with exact equality iff two different homogeneous opposite pairs have opposite signs. A matching construction attains -32J. Independent compiled C++ code enumerated all 16,777,216 spin subsets and verified full magnetization coefficients g_0=948, g_±2=672, g_±4=264, g_±6=48, g_±8=3, total 2922, from this local equality rule. This is finite exhaustive proof, not extrapolation.
